about: Every number on these slides, with its source. Live facts were read from public, read-only endpoints on October 30, 2026 at 04:52 and 07:09 UTC, and the where-it-stands and first-check facts again on October 31, 2026 at 23:24 UTC; nothing that changes state was called.

claims.number: Lease reaping runs shortly after each lease expires, and on a cron every six hours
claims.source: Tessera's Cloudflare configuration sets the cron 0 */6 * * *, whose handler runs the reaper, and the coordinator also wakes itself just after the earliest lease expiry. Its public health reported the last run at 06:00:40 UTC on October 30, 2026, read at 07:09 UTC.

claims.number: The daily check runs every 24 hours from 13:00 UTC, or on demand, and reads four services
claims.source: The daily check's public status, read on October 30, 2026 at 07:09 UTC: a 24-hour interval starting 13:00 UTC, on-demand runs only with a Tessera admin key, four services per check (Eranos, Tessera, Herma and Home's agent endpoints) and server repair off.

claims.number: The first full check ran on October 29, 2026 at 19:31 UTC, started by hand
claims.source: The daily check's public status, read on October 30, 2026 at 07:09 UTC: the latest run completed, with a manual trigger, started at 19:31:25 UTC and headed "First daily check".

claims.number: Tessera's llms.txt named 26 of the 37 tools that its tools/list serves
claims.source: The check's finding of kind llms_tool_mismatch, severity low, last seen at 19:31 UTC on October 29, 2026 and still open in its public status at 07:09 UTC on October 30. At 04:52 UTC, before the redeploy, Tessera's live llms.txt still named 26 tools and its agent card listed 37.

claims.number: A fix merged in Tessera on October 30, 2026 at 02:52 UTC and went live with the redeploy at 06:53 UTC
claims.source: Tessera pull request 20, merged at 02:52 UTC, renders every tool list from the tools/list registry; its commit says the daily check recorded the gap. Tessera pull request 21, which includes it, merged at 06:52 UTC, and its deployment is recorded at 06:53 UTC. Public GETs at 06:57 and 07:09 UTC returned an llms.txt that names all 37 tools, in the same order as the agent card. Nothing shows that a worker claimed the repair Task.

claims.number: The scheduled run on October 31, 2026 at 13:00 UTC found 4 of 4 services healthy, with no open items
claims.source: The daily check's public status, read on October 31, 2026 at 23:24 UTC: last_full_check_at 2026-10-31T13:00:16Z, trigger scheduled, status completed, 4 of 4 checked services healthy, open_gaps 0 and open_incidents 0.

claims.number: The daily check claims one scan a run and queues at most eight Tasks
claims.source: The limits in the daily check's public status, read on October 30, 2026 at 07:09 UTC: one claim and eight Tasks per cycle. Tasks beyond the cap are deferred to the next run, never dropped.

claims.number: Herma's merged code refuses an operator-paid turn without the caller's own grant
claims.source: Herma pull request 12, merged on October 29, 2026, with main CI passing: operator grants are empty by default, so no caller may use operator-funded inference, and Anthropic and OpenRouter stay paused. Herma's deployment was held in the October 29 status report, so the hosted behavior is not verified.
Public GET requests to Tessera's health and agent card and to the daily check's status at 23:24 UTC on October 31, 2026; nothing that changes state was called.

claims.number: Last lease-reaper run: 18:00 UTC on October 31, 2026
claims.source: reaper_last_run in Tessera's public health, read at 23:24 UTC on October 31, 2026, was 1793469641.399, which is 18:00:41 UTC, matching the cron every six hours.

claims.number: The daily check runs every day at 13:00 UTC through November 4, 2026; its last run, on October 31, found 4 of 4 services healthy
claims.source: The daily check's public status, read on October 31, 2026 at 23:24 UTC: cadence every 24 hours from 13:00 UTC, stop_at 2026-11-04T17:00:00Z, next_scheduled_at 2026-11-01T13:00:00Z; the last full check completed at 13:00:16 UTC on October 31 with 4 of 4 checked services healthy.

claims.number: Tessera serves list_feeds, poll_feed and publish_feed
claims.source: The tools listed in Tessera's public agent card at 07:09 UTC. Reading or publishing a feed needs a key; the unauthenticated feed list returned 401.

claims.number: Open Tasks and self-serve requester keys, live since Tessera's redeploy on October 30, 2026 at 06:53 UTC
claims.source: Tessera's access contract at /connect.json, read at 07:09 UTC: a tracked anonymous session may claim, heartbeat and submit Tasks tagged open:anonymous in the main namespace, while eq03, frontier.review and frontier.verify stay closed and its results wait for a different keyed reviewer; requester.enabled is true at POST /v1/session/requester, for a key that writes only in its organization's own org. stores and files requests only on eq01. Keyed worker keys stay admin-assisted. Both came in Tessera pull request 21, deployed at 06:53 UTC. This check signed up for nothing and claimed nothing. At the same time, Tessera's agent card and llms-full.txt still showed requester.enabled false; /connect.json is the access contract.
